method:
This batch contains 23 fresh campaign cases, distinct from all 54 earlier fresh archives: 19 antiprism cases, three prism cases and one pentakis-dodecahedron self-packing. Sixteen improve the pinned current nominal/reference bound; seven improve complete native certificates without claiming a new ideal nominal value.

The main new construction places fixed-phase antiprism rings and whole axial slots inside actual complete regular-prism parents. The forced phase comes from the full cyclic difference grid. Every child, sibling slab and inherited parent separator is retained. Literal whole-owner prefixes give additional complete cases. For six hexagonal antiprisms in a cube, one common center contraction releases the artificial parent facets while all 15 target-pair separators remain simultaneously valid; the certified side is 2.862714781480716. No angle sweep is used.

A reciprocal golden-host inclusion and common return give eleven pentakis dodecahedra in their own host at 2.82404531854329. The three prism cases retain complete source-column and height/collar operations from the reviewed bank.

All active witnesses passed independent source, full geometry and current-public/private comparisons, followed by both official checks on the packaged native files. The archive preserves complete parent packings, physical decoders, common-return certificates and original source attribution. Some provenance audit scripts require the authenticated upstream Git snapshot or reviewed-source registry; the bundled official native validators are directly replayable.

Credit the new finite constructions exactly to PingYou Ltd. Original donors and their authors remain explicitly credited. These contributions may be published under the repository’s MIT license. No global optimality is claimed. Fresh campaign cases, live site credit and submission acceptance are tracked separately.
